'''V-Davi''', known to friends as '''Davi''', was an orphaned [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]]. He was a young, slender boy with long, sandy hair that reached to his shoulders. His parents died during an outbreak of [[Toli-X]] when he was two standard years old. He enjoyed the company of animals and secretly kept them, even though he could be sent to the [[Re-Learning Circle]] if anyone found out. He was a student of the [[The Learning]], sent to the [[Learning Circle]] when his parents perished, instead of starting at the typical age of four. When he was nine years old, he became a friend of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]] while they were stuck on Kegan. He was caught trying to help the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] escape the Circle, resulting in the capture of his two pet [[Ferbil/Legends|ferbils]] and two [[Lizard/Legends|lizards]]. As a result, he was sent to the Re-Learning Circle. He later escaped with the help of the two Jedi and their [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] and became the child of [[V-Nen]] and [[O-Melie]], after their daughter, [[Olana Chion/Legends|O-Lana]], was taken to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]].<ref name="The Fight for Truth" />
